title: Header and Source File Separation
learningObjectives: Explain header declarations and source definitions.
Recognize include guards and matching function signatures.
Prevent duplicate definitions and unresolved symbols.
Create a tiny multi-file helper module with clear interfaces.

understand.concept: A header file commonly contains declarations, types and interface information. A source file contains definitions. Include guards or pragma once prevent the same header from being processed repeatedly within one translation unit.
understand.whyItMatters: Separating interface and implementation supports reuse, multiple source files, clearer dependencies and more maintainable compilation.
understand.explain: Include the header in its implementation file so the compiler checks that declarations match. Avoid defining non-inline functions in headers that are included by multiple source files, which can create duplicate definitions.
